description: Gives Fallout 4 loot and creature lists Fallout 76's rules: per-item conditions, weights, curves and flags.
x-help:
A leveled list decides what a container, a creature or a spawn gives when it is rolled. Each entry here replaces how one of your plugin's lists (or a master's list) rolls, so it can follow Fallout 76 rules instead of Fallout 4's.

Use 'Import from plugin' to copy a list from your plugin; it then rolls exactly as it does now. After that, tick behaviours under 'How it rolls', add checks to items (for example only when the player has a perk), or give the whole list checks.

If something in a list is not supported, Tales rolls that list the Fallout 4 way and the editor lists the reason under Problems. The list still saves.
